name: spark
description: Gemini-cooked prompts, modes and guardrails for Claude Code.

rewrite_models.title: Rewrite models
rewrite_models.description: Gemini models that rewrite your prompt before you send it, comma-separated; the next is tried when one is out of quota or failing

rewrite_thinking.title: Rewrite thinking level
rewrite_thinking.description: Gemini thinking level for the rewrite

route_models.title: Skill routing models
route_models.description: Gemini models that pick which skills Claude should load, comma-separated, tried in order

skill_search.title: Search skills.sh
skill_search.description: Let the routing model search skills.sh for skills you don't have and suggest installing them

min_words.title: Words before cooking
min_words.description: Prompts shorter than this are sent as typed

timeout_ms.title: Gemini timeout per try (ms)
timeout_ms.description: How long one Gemini call may take. Each model gets three tries before the next model is asked
